Dear Distance Users,

I have calculated some population density estimates for red squirrels =
using distance sampling for my undergrad. thesis. Can a Z-test be used =
to compare these density estimates and if so how exactly? I haven't been =
able to find anything in the Distance Sampling book by Buckland et al., =
(1993) on this and would appreciate any references or advice. Thanks in =
advance for your help.

Best wishes

Micheal McGoldrick
Dept. of Zoology
Trinity College Dublin
Ireland

E mail: mmc...@eircom.net
